description: A fighter charges three goblins. The fight runs through setup_combat/combat_round/end_combat and the loot through award_treasure or generate_treasure.

secrets.text: Brother Kael, a cult ritualist, waits in the throne room with a bound skeleton; he flees through the vestry when the first goblin dies.

beats.player: Three goblins block the passage. Bren draws his sword and charges them.
Bren keeps fighting until they are all down, then searches the bodies.
